svg.title: Array spatial sampling and beamforming
svg.desc: Matched responses, exact alias, the same finite test record, and a separate steering mismatch experiment.
svg.title: Array spatial aliasing and beamforming on fixed synthetic data

cc:Work.dc:title: Array spatial aliasing and beamforming on fixed synthetic data
cc:Work.dc:description: Four panels compare matched weights, exact spatial alias, same held-out record, and a separate steering mismatch condition.
